damage_symptoms: Rosetted flowers with petals twisted and tied with silk; young bolls shed; larvae burrow inside bolls feeding on lint and immature seeds, causing stained lint.
etl: 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive days or 10% damaged green bolls/flowers.
biological_ipm: Install gossyplure pheromone traps @ 12/ha; release Trichogramma bactrae @ 1.5 lakh eggs/ha at weekly intervals; spray Neem oil @ 5 ml/L.
chemical_control: Emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4 g/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3 ml/L (CIBRC approved; PHI: 15 days).

damage_symptoms: Female makes two distinct ring-like girdles on stem/petiole and lays egg; plant above the upper girdle withers and drops; dry twigs visible across field.
etl: 1 damaged plant per meter row length.
biological_ipm: Hand collection and destruction of girdled plant parts during initial 30 days; foliar spray of Beauveria bassiana @ 5 g/L.
chemical_control: Thiamethoxam 12.6% + Lambda-cyhalothrin 9.5% ZC @ 0.3 ml/L (CIBRC approved; PHI: 21 days).

damage_symptoms: Nymphs and adults lacerate leaf tissue and suck sap; leaves show silvery patches, white streaks, and curl inwards; bulb development severely stunted.
etl: 30 thrips per plant at vegetative stage.
biological_ipm: Install blue sticky traps @ 20/ha; spray 5% NSKE or Verticillium lecanii @ 5 g/L; avoid excess nitrogen.
chemical_control: Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5 ml/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3 ml/L (CIBRC approved; PHI: 10 days).

damage_symptoms: Larva bores into central shoot causing dead heart in tillering phase, and white earhead (empty chaffy panicles) during flowering phase.
etl: 2 egg masses/sq.m or 10% dead hearts/white earheads.
biological_ipm: Install pheromone traps @ 12/ha; release Trichogramma japonicum @ 1.0 lakh/ha weekly; clip seedling leaf tips before transplanting.
chemical_control: Cartap hydrochloride 50% SP @ 2.0 g/L or Chlorantraniliprole 0.4% GR @ 10 kg/ha (CIBRC approved; PHI: 21 days).
